summary.text: Mandy Smith Weirich is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 67, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She ran for West Virginia State Senate District 11 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Weirich was the Democratic nominee for State Senate District 11 in 2024, losing the general election to Robbie Morris, 75.9 percent to 24.1 percent.
In 2026 she advanced from the Democratic primary on May 12 and faces Republican Les Mallow in a race with no incumbent.
